label: Diagram 1.9
caption: Diagram 1.9 | Measuring tapered treads Spiral and helical stairs
description:
Diagram 1.9, titled "Measuring tapered treads," consists of two parts, a. and b., depicting how to measure the going of spiral and helical stairs.

Part a. shows a plan view of a stair with a "Stair width less than 1m". The treads are tapered. A dimension indicates a "50mm minimum tread width at narrow end". Two arrows labelled "Equal" show the width at the narrow end of two adjacent treads. A central line runs through the treads, with an arrow indicating "Measure going at centre of tread; measure from curved stair line, even when tread is in rectangular closure". Text at the top reads "See paras 1.25–1.27".

Part b. shows a plan view of a curved stair with a "Stair width 1m or more". The treads are wider at the outer edge. An arrow pointing to the tread depth is labelled "Going (not less than minimum for stair category see para 1.3)". Another arrow indicates "Going (not more than maximum for stair category see para 1.3)". A central line shows "Landing length measured on centre line". Two width dimensions at the bottom of the stair are both marked "270mm". An arrow labelled "Width" points across the stair.
